items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: He never even used Joe. He couldn't play, you know.

ctx.x: And who'd you say was a guitar player, a banjo player? Buddy Manatee. Buddy Manatee and Simon. And Simon. And no piano, of course. No. No violin. No. No.

Now that trombone, I can't place where it was. It might have been yanked. It might have been. I'm not sure. Yanked Johnson. Uh-huh. Trying to see who else was the nice trombone player on at that time. I know he had George Washington later. Oh, yeah. He was out way later. That way. I can't picture who that was. No. No. He never even used Joe. He couldn't play, you know.
Joe played with one joe. No. He couldn't play, you know.
